package dailyassignments;

public class FindDupNosInArray {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		/*
		 * Find Duplicate Elements

			Write a Java program to identify and print all duplicate elements in an array. 
			Each duplicate element should be printed only once.
			Input:
			{10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 10, 50, 30, 60}
			Expected Output:
			Duplicate elements: 10 20 30
		 */
		int[] arrDup = new int[9];
		arrDup[0] = 10;
		arrDup[1] = 20;
		arrDup[2] = 30;
		arrDup[3] = 20;
		arrDup[4] = 40;
		arrDup[5] = 10;
		arrDup[6] = 50;
		arrDup[7] = 30;
		arrDup[8] = 60;
		boolean Duplicate = false;
		
		for(int arrIter = 0;arrIter<arrDup.length;arrIter++)
		{
			for(int arrCompIter = arrIter+1;arrCompIter<arrIter;arrCompIter++)
			{
				if(arrDup[arrIter]==arrDup[arrCompIter])
				{
					System.out.println(arrIter+" ");
					Duplicate = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(Duplicate)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for(int arrCompIter=arrIter+1;arrCompIter<arrDup.length;arrCompIter++)
			{
				if(arrDup[arrIter]==arrDup[arrCompIter])
				{
					System.out.print(arrDup[arrIter] +" ");
					break;
				}
			}
			
		}
		
		
	}

}
